Chevron U.S.A. Inc. v. Natural Resources Defense Council, Inc., 467 U.S. 837 (1984).
The Supreme Court described a two step framework for reviewing an agency interpretation of a statute it administers. At step one a court asks whether Congress has directly spoken to the precise question at issue. If the statute is silent or ambiguous, step two asks whether the agency interpretation is based on a permissible construction of the statute.
